title: When the Group Chat Burns
author: August Underhill
blurb: Elodie Thornbury, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide who to be when the labels come off before the final audition.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
